large_shell_policy.reason: their entire albedo is warning-stripe paint; any large face would read as a hazard sign (user bug 2026-10-27). They stay in MATERIAL_WHITELIST for completeness but must never appear in a shipped model.

material_source_provenance: Ground truth read from the installed game's Material assets (Timberborn_Data/resources.assets, 660 assemblies / 1536 Texture2D): each material's m_SavedProperties._MainTex (Texture2D name) and _Color tint, extracted 2026-10-27 with AssetStudioModCLI (materials enumerated via a small AssetStudio probe) and cross-checked against the runtime UV contract in Timberborn.PrefabOptimization.AutoAtlaser / AutoAtlasingPrefabOptimizer IL: a mesh UV is remapped as uv_atlas = uv_material * UVScale + UVOffset with UVScale = 1/sizeMultiplier, so normalized (u,v) inside the material's own _D texture is preserved (AutoAtlas or direct material, identical sampling). The _Color tint multiplies the sampled albedo.

uv_convention: pixel_rect = [x0, y0, x1, y1], TOP-LEFT pixel origin, exclusive x1/y1 (same as art/atlas_layout.REGIONS and art/png_stats.py). uv_rect = [u0, v0, u1, v1] with u0=x0/W, u1=x1/W, v0=1-y1/H, v1=1-y0/H (bottom-left UV origin, i.e. art/atlas_layout.px_rect_to_uv flips v).
